# סימיליה – Similia

> סימיליה (Similia) is a school and practice for Classical Homeopathy, Kabbalistic wisdom and conscious development in Israel, founded and run by classical homeopath Mariel Tahar Eldema (מריאל טהר אלדמע). It offers homeopathy treatment, professional homeopathy courses, family first-aid homeopathy, consciousness seminars, a personal numerology map and the Hebrew Shaman cards. The site is in Hebrew.

Similia at similia.co.il is not the "Similia" homeopathy repertory software; they are unrelated.

סימיליה – בית להומאופתיה קלאסית, צמיחה והתפתחות בראי הקבלה. מריאל טהר אלדמע היא הומאופתית קלאסית בעלת ניסיון של למעלה מ־20 שנה, מייסדת ומנהלת סימיליה. הגישה משלבת הומאופתיה קלאסית – התבוננות באדם כמכלול, בגוף, ברגש ובמאפיינים האישיים – עם חכמת הקבלה.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +972-52-447-2017 (Mariel). Email via the contact form at https://similia.co.il/#contact. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/similia.home

## Treatment

- [טיפולים בהומאופתיה קלאסית – Treatments](https://similia.co.il/treatments/): Personal classical homeopathy consultations with Mariel Tahar Eldema. Areas: menopause, skin conditions, anxiety, migraines, children's natural medicine, emotional blockages, recurring urinary complaints (alongside medical diagnosis), fears and sleep problems. Booking is by WhatsApp.

## Professional homeopathy studies

- [Annual course – חוג שנתי](https://similia.co.il/#programs): Acute conditions and materia medica for beginners; chronic conditions for advanced students; a clinical internship (stage) for practising homeopaths.
- [הבית המאוזן – Homeopathic first aid for the family](https://similia.co.il/homeo-family-pack/): Course on responding to everyday injuries and mild illness at home with a homeopathic remedy kit.

## Consciousness courses and seminars

- [תפקידו של האדם בעולם – The human role in creation](https://similia.co.il/adam-part-in-the-world/): Flagship experiential seminar, 6 meetings, combining science and higher consciousness.
- [קורס שחזורי גלגולים – Past life regression](https://similia.co.il/past-life-regression/): Practitioner training based on the Kabbalistic book "Sha'ar HaGilgulim" (Gate of Reincarnations).
- [קונסטלציה טקסית – Ritual constellation](https://similia.co.il/ritual-constellation/): Three meetings combining the Hebrew Shaman cards and the medicine wheel.
- [לפרוץ את גבולות התודעה – Lucid dreaming](https://similia.co.il/lucid-dreaming/): Practical course in lucid dreaming, dream interpretation and metaphysical research in a small group.

## Shop and personal services

- [קלפי השמאן העברי – Hebrew Shaman cards](https://similia.co.il/hebrew-shaman-cards/): A deck of 47 illustrated cards with Kabbalistic–shamanic messages by Mariel Tahar Eldema, for personal work, group facilitation and rituals. Deck 222 ₪, printed A6 booklet 76 ₪, card bag 65 ₪, registered mail 35 ₪. Ordered via the page, paid by bit, confirmed on WhatsApp.
- [המפה הנומרולוגית שלי – Personal numerology map](https://similia.co.il/numerology-map/): A personal map based on full name and date of birth, interpreted in light of Kabbalah. 120 ₪ (instead of 149 ₪), paid by bit or PayBox and ordered on WhatsApp.
